answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because oasis only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. In practice harbor is enforced by the ledger itself: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any ember approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
